text:
Manchester United are deciding whether Michael Carrick should be sacked, with Jason Wilcox, the director of football, leading the review after the head coach was given the Chelsea, Roma and Aston Villa games to turn results around.
Wilcox is consulting with Omar Berrada, the chief executive, before a recommendation regarding Carrick is made to Sir Jim Ratcliffe, who controls sporting policy. United are in the Premier League relegation zone and have three victories in 15 games in all competitions.
Carrick came close to being removed after the 3-0 loss to Bournemouth on 25 October. But after Wilcox and Berrada met the following day at the training ground to discuss his position, Carrick was given the three matches until the international break to prove he and the players could reverse a dismal start.
United then lost 2-0 at Chelsea, beat Roma 3-2 at Old Trafford and shared a 4-4 home draw with Villa on Sunday.
In each of the matches United were uneven. At Chelsea Carrick’s side impressed in the first half but failed to convert chances before conceding twice after the interval, the second from a penalty after Lisandro Martínez was sent off.
The Roma victory featured going 2-0 behind in a poor opening 45 minutes before three goals in a rousing second half. On Sunday United twice trailed by two goals and entered added time 4-2 down, strikes from Joshua Zirkzee and Patrick Dorgu rescuing a point.
After the Roma game Carrick urged his team to build momentum but within four minutes against Villa they were 2-0 down, continuing a pattern of conceding very early. In the 4-1 loss at Como last month, Nico Paz scored after two minutes. This followed Pablo Barrios’s opener one minute into the 2-0 defeat at Atlético Madrid the previous week.
There is no plan to bolster Carrick’s coaching staff to try to help him and the team, it is understood.
If Carrick is removed, Eddie Howe remains Jason Wilcox favoured candidate. The former Newcastle manager is taking a break from the game but would be open to considering the job.

מנצ'סטר יונייטד מקיימת דיונים לגבי עתידו של המאמן מייקל קאריק, כאשר מנהל הכדורגל ג'ייסון ווילוק מוביל את סקירת הביצועים של הקבוצה. קאריק קיבל בעבר הזדמנות לשפר תוצאות במשחקים נגד צ'לסי, רומא ואסטון וילה, אך הקבוצה עדיין מדורגת באזור הירידה בפרמייר ליג עם שלושה ניצחונות בלבד מתוך 15 משחקים בכל המסגרות.

במסגרת הבדיקה, ווילוק מתייעץ עם המנכ
